metadata.name: Ocean acidification effects on Limacina helicina: carbonate chemistry and respiration data
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment dataset measuring carbonate chemistry parameters (pHT, pCO2, Omega aragonite/calcite, DIC, AT) and respiration rates in the sea snail Limacina helicina under supersaturated and undersaturated CO2 treatments. Samples collected from Station 9 in the NE Pacific (48.43°N, 126.23°W) on September 1, 2019. Dataset includes 20 samples with balanced treatment allocation (10 supersaturated, 10 undersaturated), comprising both incubation and non-incubation controls.
